data.name: Dank Wizard Saga
data.detailed_description:
Dank Wizard Saga

The Orb of Eternal Chill has been stolen, and the kingdom is spiraling into total chaos.

Step into the robe of the Dank Wizard and embark on a retro-inspired action-adventure filled with dangerous dungeons, bizarre monsters, questionable heroes, and enough magical plants to keep the entire realm vibing.

Explore a handcrafted world packed with secrets, puzzles, hidden upgrades, and unforgettable characters. Battle your way through forests, swamps, ruins, and dungeons while unlocking an arsenal of unique weapons and abilities.

From humble beginnings armed with nothing but a stick, you'll discover powerful upgrades including whips, magical seed bags, blasters, giant bongs, and other strange relics on your quest to stop the mysterious Dramathar and restore balance to the kingdom of Mellownia.

Features

  • Retro 8-bit inspired action-adventure gameplay

  • Explore a connected fantasy world full of secrets and hidden treasures

  • Multiple dungeons with unique enemies, bosses, and rewards

  • Collect powerful weapons and magical upgrades

  • Solve puzzles and complete humorous side quests

  • Meet a cast of eccentric characters and ancient stoner sages

  • Fight bizarre enemies ranging from blobs and eyeballs to giant dungeon bosses

  • Pixel-art visuals inspired by classic NES adventures

  • A comedic fantasy story packed with stoner humor and absurd dialogue

The fate of the Orb of Eternal Chill rests in your hands.

Stay chill, Wizbro!

content_descriptors.notes:
Dank Wizard Saga contains cartoon fantasy violence and frequent comedic references to a fictional magical plant and smoking culture. Players explore dungeons, battle enemies, collect magical plants, and acquire fantasy-themed smoking devices as weapons and tools. All content is presented in a humorous pixel-art style and is not intended to depict realistic drug use.

The game contains no nudity, sexual content, graphic violence, gore, self-harm, or realistic depictions of substance abuse.
